verdict.query_population_substitution: The contract asks for the #11901 corpus on the capture prior and the DECLARED USER-SEARCH QUERY SET on the MCP/SDK door. That declared set contains NO `_` query, so the mechanism cannot move it — and must not (byte-identity). The gain is therefore measured with the #11901 name population on BOTH doors (the substitution), and the declared set is measured for INERTNESS on both doors (identical ordered ids, identical emitted bytes) rather than for a gain it structurally cannot have.
